g.text: ROGUE SHOOTER · TITLE MENU · #92 · C: FIELD JOURNAL
Concept sheet, drawn in SVG by Claude (no image model). Not shipped. Reply Pick: A, B or C on the pull request.
WORDMARK AT 3X (drawn as pixel rects, never painted: R2, R24)
"ROGUE" at 3x; in game each letter pixel is 8 px on desktop
IN CONTEXT: PLAY → CLASS SELECT (existing screen)
Idea: a parchment page pinned to the wood board, like the art sheet: an ink-stamped title, a small iso diorama of the Marksman facing slimes, and stamped tab buttons.
Risk: the calmest and most readable, but it says less about action; a bright parchment card is a big jump from the dark overlays the other menus use.
